inheritanceRule: Every omitted field inherits the resolved Warpriest parent value.

profiles.name: Calamity Caller

constraints.summary: A calamity caller must be an elf.
A calamity caller must select the Earthquake, Flood, Tornado, or Wildfire blessing as one of his two blessings.

evidence.section: Catastrophic Blessing / Calamity / Acid Rain / Blizzard
evidence.reason: The archetype’s Catastrophic Blessing / Calamity / Acid Rain / Blizzard package materially changes area multi target damage from the Warpriest baseline.

profiles.playerSummary: While all elves feel a deep connection to nature, some elven priests take this bond further, using their link to call down the wrath of nature upon their enemies
profiles.tradeoff: It replaces or alters Blessings; Focus Weapon; Sacred Weapon; Bonus Feats; Aspect of War; those base-class tools are exchanged for the archetype’s more specialised package.
